metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2012 · Pitch Perfect
metas.description: Beca, a freshman at Barden University, is cajoled into joining The Bellas, her school's all-girls singing group. Injecting some much needed energy into their repertoire, The Bellas take on their male rivals in a campus competition.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2019 · Rocketman
metas.description: The musical fantasy about Elton John's breakthrough years, from his time as a prodigy at the Royal Academy of Music through his influential and enduring musical partnership with Bernie Taupin.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2013 · Begin Again
metas.description: A chance encounter between a down-and-out music business executive, and a young singer songwriter new to Manhattan, turns into a promising collaboration between the two talents.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2013 · Inside Llewyn Davis
metas.description: A week in the life of a young singer as he navigates the Greenwich Village folk scene of 1961.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2015 · Youth
metas.description: Retired orchestra conductor Fred Ballinger is on vacation with his daughter Lena and his film director best friend Mick Boyle in the Alps when he receives an invitation from Queen Elizabeth II to perform for Prince Philip's birthday.
